name: topo-background
title: Topo Background
description: A full-bleed map of thin topographic contour lines with small elevation numbers, slowly drifting across a dark stage. Moving the pointer raises a hill of tighter rings, and a click sends ripples outward through the terrain.
use: A hero or section needs a quiet, technical backdrop that rewards pointer movement without fighting the copy.
avoid: It runs a drawing loop and needs a parent with real height; touch screens get no hover hill.
a11y: Pointer hill and click ripple are mouse-only and the canvas is hidden from assistive tech; motion stops under reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A near-black stage covered edge to edge with thin pale contour lines that loop into hills and hollows at uneven spacing. Tiny elevation numbers ride along some lines, and a centred white headline with a grey subline sits over the middle of the map.
behaves: The lines drift on their own, slowly. Hovering raises a hill that slides after the pointer while the rings crowd around it, and clicking sends a fading ripple train outward. The top and bottom edges fade into the page.
customise: Props set contour spacing, drift speed, pointer interactivity, terrain seed and whether elevation numbers print; pass children to replace the default headline and copy.
weight: heavy: Rebuilds a full contour field on a canvas about every frame; idle frames are halved.
